subject: First-run packaging concession — VP/CFO signoff requested
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@pulsehealth.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@pulsehealth.co>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: first-run packaging concession for PulseHealth POC

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the routing options. We want to move the POC forward quickly but we need a one-time "first-run" packaging concession to absorb extra integration and compliance QA for our regulated workflows. Specifically: 

- One month of waived hosting fees for a dedicated staging pool while we complete SOC checklists
- 2 additional operator seats for 90 days (for our deployment engineers) at no charge
- A capped add-on for SSO and custom logging at an agreed fixed fee (estimate attached)

We know this is outside standard packaging; our procurement lead (cc'd) asked whether Redwood can approve a small concession that doesn't set a broad precedent. We've attached our requirements and a short SOW.

Can you share an internal approval path and timeline? We would like to start provisioning the staging pool by Aug 1.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Partnerships, PulseHealth

Attachments: pulse_health_requirements.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@pulsehealth.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: first-run packaging concession for PulseHealth POC

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. We're excited to push this forward.

Quick answer: we can probably accommodate a constrained, one-time concession but it will need VP/CFO signoff because it touches waived hosting fees + seat credits. I need to pull together a short memo for approval with the commercial tradeoffs and guardrails.

Requested from you: can you confirm the total expected 3-month token/embedding volume for the POC and whether PulseHealth will commit to a 6-month post-POC evaluation period if the POC completes successfully? Those commit windows help the approval.

I will loop in pricing and finance and get a proposed concession structure back to you by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: internal: recommended concession structure for PulseHealth (draft)

Team — drafting the memo for Naomi. Summary and recommendation below; see attached XLS for line-item impact.

Summary recommendation (keeps fiscal exposure < $18k estimated over 3 months):
- Waive hosting fees for dedicated staging pool for 30 days (cost to us: estimated $9k)
- 2 operator seats free for 90 days (nominal seat cost waived: $4.5k)
- Fixed $6k professional services cap for SSO+logging (paid by PulseHealth upon SOW signature)
- Condition: PulseHealth signs a 6-month evaluation MOU that includes a minimum usage floor for months 2–6 or repayments of the waived hosting fee pro rata

Risks / guardrails:
- Avoid precedent: flag the concession as "first-run, one-off" in contract language, limit to this specific account and project name
- Limit timing: concession applies only if provisioning starts by Aug 7, 2028

Attachments: first_run_packaging_breakdown.xlsx

Please review the memo bullets. If you approve, I'll format a two-page exception memo for Naomi (CFO) and include a short bullet list for the VP.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Director, Commercial Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Exec signoff requested: PulseHealth first-run packaging concession (summary)

Naomi —

Quick summary and ask: PulseHealth (large healthcare prospect) requests a one-time concession to cover staging hosting and temporary operator seats to accelerate a regulated POC. We recommend approving under the following constrained terms: 

1) Waive dedicated staging hosting fees for 30 days (est. $9k cost to Redwood)
2) Provide 2 operator seats free for 90 days (est. $4.5k)
3) Professional services (SSO + logging) contracted at a fixed $6k deliverable fee
4) Condition: PulseHealth signs a 6-month MOU with a minimum usage floor for months 2–6 or repay waived fees pro rata
5) Timebox: concession valid only if staging provisioned by Aug 7
6) Contract language: explicit "first-run, non-precedent" clause; limited to deal D-88432-PULSE and project "PulseHealth POC"

I have attached the pricing impact workbook and the external requirements doc. Karthik drafted the line item memo below.

Requested action: Please approve the concession as-is, or flag material changes. If approved, we will circulate final contract language for signature and push provisioning.

Thanks for the quick review — happy to jump on a 15-min call.

— Marissa
Head of Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: first_run_packaging_breakdown.xlsx, pulse_health_requirements.docx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec signoff requested: PulseHealth first-run packaging concession (summary)

Marissa / team — thanks for the clear memo. I approve this exception under the conditions outlined below: 

- Approval granted: waive staging hosting 30 days + 2 operator seats for 90 days.
- Finance condition: include a repayment clause pro rata tied to a 6-month MOU with minimum usage floor; finance to verify the usage floor language with Legal.
- Approval caveat: this concession is explicitly labeled as a one-off, non-precedent exception. Ensure the final contract highlights scope, dates, and identifies this deal by D-88432-PULSE.
- Operational note: provisioning must be completed by Aug 5 to meet the tight window.

Please prepare the final contract amendment and route to Legal/DocuSign. Once DocuSign envelope is sent, confirm with procurement that the staging pool is scheduled.

Naomi Feldman
CFO, Redwood Inference
